name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) and the Precedence chain (blocker_moved and has_door_key before door_open, door_open before target_picked_up) force every required event. The ball and key have no order between them, as the task says, and no clause is redundant.

texts: Eventually pick up the mission's target box in the other room.
The box is picked up only after the door has been unlocked and opened.
The door is unlocked only after the blocking ball has been moved away.
The door is unlocked only after the matching key has been acquired; the ball and key may come in either order.
